'''Raithal''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] near the border with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
Under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Raithal produced officers for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="HNN 52" /> In the final decades of the Republic, there were so many students at the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] that applicants had to be turned away. To counter this situation, [[Corulag Academy]] was created on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] as a branch of Raithal Academy.<ref name="Jedi Emergency">''[[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency]]''</ref> [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] lied about his age in order to enter the Raithal Academy.<ref name="NEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
The Raithal Academy, of all the [[Imperial Army Officer Training Academy|Imperial Army Officer Training Academies]], was considered the foremost school. It became renowned for producing the best officers in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook, Second Edition" />

Following the collision of two [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]] that were pursuing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], the notorious "[[Incident at Anoat]]" became required reading at the Raithal Academy.<ref name="Egregious Pilot Error">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Egregious Pilot Error}}</ref>
